subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Sep 28): Léger, steins, unmarked Ridgewood room
opener: German Unity Day lands on a Saturday this year and the last warm Sunday is probably this Sunday, so the week writes itself: liters on the Greenpoint waterfront, a long melodic set in an open-air warehouse, dancing in a yard before dark. Two of these need tickets before Friday.

picks.headline: Sébastien Léger's long set in the Ruins
picks.title: Lost Miracle: Sébastien Léger x Roy Rosenfeld
picks.when: Fri Oct 2, 3pm start (open-air, runs into the evening)
picks.why: This is your lane done properly: melodic, progressive, played long-form instead of chopped into festival slots. Léger and Roy Rosenfeld build the kind of set you follow for hours, and the Ruins is open-air so it never feels like a box. Closer to the Tinlicker and Prydz end of your library than anything else in the city this week.
picks.heads_up: It starts at 3pm and runs into the evening, so this is a daylight party, not a 4am one. From $30 on Dice. Open-air in October means bring a jacket. It is a 3pm open-air daytime party, not a late-night show, and doNYC already flags it sold out, so check DICE before going.
picks.invite_text: Friday afternoon: Sebastien Leger doing a long melodic set in the open-air part of Knockdown, starts at 3. Tickets are cheap, I'm buying two if you're in.

verification.note: DICE blocks fetching, so I read the promoter's own page (grayarea.co/events/lost-miracle-and-guests-oct-2-2026): Friday Oct 2, 2026, 3 PM, Ruins at Knockdown Center, tickets via DICE; the doNYC event page agrees on Fri Oct 2 3:00PM but marks it Sold Out while Gray Area still links live tickets.

picks.headline: Liter steins on the Greenpoint waterfront
picks.title: Zum Schneider Oktoberfest — "Munich on the East River" (closing weekend)
picks.when: Fri Oct 2 to Sun Oct 4, Friday runs as one session, 5pm to 10pm
picks.price: general seating $25 ($35 Saturdays), reserved $35 ($45 Saturdays), VIP table $110, rooftop biergarten $15
picks.why: Closing weekend of the Zum Schneider Wiesn, and Saturday is German Unity Day. This is the actual Bavarian version, oompah from Mösl Franzi and festbier by the liter, not a lederhosen frat tent. Beer hall downstairs, biergarten over the East River upstairs, and it ends at a reasonable hour.
picks.heads_up: Saturday pricing: $35 general seating, $45 reserved, $110 for a VIP table, $15 if you only want the rooftop biergarten. Sessions are ticketed in advance, so confirm the Saturday session time when you buy for four. Friday Oct 2 is a single 5pm-10pm session; the early/late split he wants is Saturday Oct 3 (12-4:45pm and 5:15-10pm).
picks.invite_text: Saturday is German Unity Day and Zum Schneider's Oktoberfest closes that weekend in Greenpoint. Getting tickets for the afternoon session, liters and a brass band, you in?

verification.note: Read nyc.zumschneider.com/oktoberfest-26: festival Sept 25-Oct 4 at 12 Franklin St, Greenpoint; Fri 10/02 is 5pm-10pm, the early/late session split is Sat 10/03, and ticket tiers are listed with prices.

picks.headline: Elsewhere goes off-site to h0l0
picks.title: Elsewhere x h0l0: not without friends — Luke Alessi, William Kiss + more
picks.why: Elsewhere takes its booking to h0l0, the tiny unmarked Ridgewood room, with Luke Alessi leading. No signage, no marketing budget, a couple hundred people at most. This is the had-to-know-about-it end of the melodic house scene you keep asking for.
picks.heads_up: Doors 10pm and it runs late, so this is a sometimes-thing. Small capacity and Eventbrite only, so grab tickets early in the week.
picks.invite_text: Saturday late: Elsewhere is throwing a night at h0l0, that unmarked little club in Ridgewood. Small room, proper house, I'll get the tickets.

verification.note: Elsewhere's own event page states Saturday October 3, 2026, door time 10:00 PM, at H0L0, 21+; no price shown on the page.

picks.headline: The FreakShow roast at All Night Skate
picks.title: The FreakShow 4 Year Anniversary: The Roast of Siobhan the Third
picks.when: Thu Oct 1, night; door time not stated in the announcement
picks.why: Your Thursday slot, at a bar you already love, on its own scene night. Four years of The FreakShow and this one is a full roast of the host, which means it will be loose and mean and nobody's filming it for content. Drag with the guys in Bed-Stuy beats anything on a screen.
picks.heads_up: Announced on Instagram with no ticket link, so treat it as pay at the bar and message the venue about door time before you commit the group. Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.
picks.invite_text: Thursday at All Night Skate: the FreakShow anniversary, they're roasting the host. Meet me there around nine.

verification.note: Instagram will not load for fetching; Thotyssey/Tockify listings show Freakshow is Siobhan the Third's monthly at All Night Skate on first Thursdays at 9pm (Oct 1, 2026 is a first Thursday), but no page I could read states the four-year anniversary roast date, time or price.

picks.headline: Daikoku cars at Nowadays Creative Lab
picks.title: LockedIn Auto Club x Nowadays Creative Lab: GET LICENSED
picks.why: You said Daikoku NYC was the deep scene you wanted more of. Here it is indoors: Daikoku and Gearheads cars parked outside, headshots printed onto a free shirt, drinks and burgers, 5pm to 8pm. You leave holding something, which is the interactive part.
picks.heads_up: Free and the shirts run out, so get there closer to 5 than 7. It overlaps with the Léger start in Maspeth, so it's one or the other unless you're fine skipping the first hours out there. Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.
picks.invite_text: Friday 5 to 8, car meet thing on the Lower East Side with the Daikoku crew, free shirts printed on the spot. Come look at cars with me.

verification.note: Instagram is not fetchable; searches only confirm Nowadays Creative Lab is a print shop at 147 Orchard St on the Lower East Side, with nothing published about a GET LICENSED event on Oct 2.

picks.headline: Mister Sunday in the Nowadays yard
picks.title: Mister Sunday: Eamon Harkin and Justin Carter
picks.why: Probably one of the last warm Sundays, and this is the closest thing the city has to that BQE day party you still talk about. Justin Carter plays 3 to 6, Eamon Harkin takes 6 to 8, outdoors in a yard, crowd there for the records. Wrapped by nine, which is the whole point at this stage of your life.
picks.heads_up: Outdoor and weather-dependent, and it's a recurring party, so confirm on the Nowadays calendar the day before. Go at 3 rather than 6 if you want space.
picks.invite_text: Sunday afternoon: Mister Sunday in the Nowadays backyard, 3pm start, probably the last warm one. Come early and we'll actually get a table.

verification.note: RA event 2503324 states Sun, Oct 4, 2026, 15:00-21:00 at Nowadays, Ridgewood, with Justin 3-6pm, Eamon 6-8pm and both 8-9pm; RSVP discounts noted, no flat price listed.

picks.headline: Mr. Choade's variety show at Slipper Room
picks.title: Mr. Choade's Upstairs Downstairs
picks.when: Sat Oct 3, evening show, with a separate midnight show the same night
picks.why: The date-night one. Burlesque, sideshow, magic and comedy in an 1890s room on Orchard Street that's been doing this since 1999. Same register as Sunken Harbor Club but with tassels: you can talk to the bartender between acts. Dinner downtown first, then walk in.
picks.heads_up: Take the evening show, not the midnight one. Ticket price wasn't confirmed, so check the venue calendar when you book, and dress like you meant it.
picks.invite_text: Got a sitter idea for Saturday: dinner downtown then the variety show at the Slipper Room, burlesque and magic in an old Orchard Street room. Want in?

verification.note: Slipper Room's own tickets page lists Mr. Choade's Upstairs Downstairs Oct 03, 2026 8:00 PM plus a separate Slipper Room Midnight Show the same night; no ticket prices are posted (Fri/Sat are general admission, no drink minimum).

radar.headline: UFC 334 at the Garden, two title fights
radar.title: Polymarket UFC 334: Gane vs Hokit (plus Kayla Harrison vs Amanda Nunes)
radar.when: Sat Nov 14, early prelims 5pm, prelims 7pm, main card 9pm
radar.why: The one big fight night of the fall in your city: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight interim belt and Harrison vs Nunes on the same card. You train and you teach; this is your crew's night out. Tickets went on sale three days ago.
radar.book_by: on sale now via Ticketmaster, buy this week before the good sections get resold

verification.note: UFC.com's event page for Polymarket UFC 334 states Sat, Nov 14, 2026 at Madison Square Garden with early prelims 5:00 PM, prelims 7:00 PM and main card 9:00 PM, and lists Harrison vs Nunes on the card.

radar.headline: Circoloco's last nights at Brooklyn Storehouse
radar.title: Circoloco NYC (Halloween weekend, closing nights)
radar.when: Fri Oct 30 to Sat Oct 31, doors 10pm, goes very late
radar.address: Brooklyn Navy Yard, Building 293, Assembly Rd
radar.why: Rampa, &ME and Dixon across Halloween weekend, which is the Berlin melodic-house axis you actually listen to, and the listings say the building closes after these shows. Your once-a-year big warehouse night, a short ride from Fort Greene.
radar.book_by: buy now; Halloween weekend plus a venue's final nights is a fast sellout

verification.note: Circoloco's own page lists Brooklyn Storehouse 30.10 & 31.10 with the full lineup, and the doNYC listing for the same event gives Fri Oct 30 - Sat Oct 31 at 10:00PM; no price published.

radar.title: The Blaze (live)

anytime.headline: Bathhouse on Atlantic Ave, from $29
anytime.title: Bathhouse Atlantic Ave day pass
anytime.when: open daily, roughly 8am to 11:30pm; book a slot, stay as long as you want
anytime.price: from $29, varies by day and time
anytime.why: The newest Bathhouse is a walk from your door: banya at 190, a 50-degree plunge, and free Aufguss ceremonies during your visit. Book a late Thursday slot with one of the guys and you're home by eleven.

verification.note: Bathhouse's Atlantic Ave page states day passes start at $29 with prices varying by day and time; it is a standing venue, so 'anytime' is right.

anytime.headline: Zum Stammtisch, Glendale, unchanged since 1972
anytime.title: Zum Stammtisch
anytime.when: kitchen open from midday most days; closed Mondays
anytime.why: The German room that is actually German: wurst plates, schnitzel, liters, taxidermy, no line culture and nothing to game. A table of four is a complete guys' night.
anytime.heads_up: Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.

family.headline: Art of Manga opens at the Brooklyn Museum
family.title: Art of Manga opening weekend
family.when: Sat Oct 3 to Sun Oct 4, museum hours, go at opening
family.price: Manga Fan Pass $75 covers one adult plus a guest for the run; standard timed tickets sold separately
family.why: Original pages from Araki, Oda, Takahashi and Taniguchi, hung right-to-left the way you'd read them, ten minutes from your door and flat enough for a stroller. Go right at opening on Saturday and you're out before the nap window closes. The adults get something to actually look at, and if you go twice the $75 Manga Fan Pass covers you both for the run.
family.heads_up: Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.
family.invite_text: The Brooklyn Museum opens its manga show Saturday. Want to do timed tickets right at opening and be home by lunch?

notes: Thin on fights: UFC 332 is a screen event with no verified NYC watch party, so I left it out rather than sending you to a random bar. I also skipped Company XIV's Petite Rouge and the Strong Rope pop-up since we already ran both, and the Nursery day party still has an unresolved date conflict.
